title: Stephanie C NDE 4984
content: My NDE took place three days after the birth of my son. I had a cesarean section and the operation itself was flawless. However, the nurses made the mistake of not getting me up and around after the surgery until this afternoon on the third day. When a nurse and my husband finally tried to get me to sit up and then stand, things got messy. I stood up and blood poured out of me like someone was dumping a huge never-ending bucket of it on the floor. The last thing I remember was looking down at the flood of blood everywhere and said to my husband Kevin, 'Whoa, that's a lot of blood.' The next thing I remember was running through a field by myself in a white gown, picking flowers, smiling, laughing. This was a beautiful place with yellow and white flowers everywhere (I know they weren't daisies, they looked like oversized posies). There was a waterfall down the path with stone on either side of it. I just remember being so happy, felt a huge amount of love, I didn't ever want to leave this place. The next thing I remember, they were trying to rouse me with smelling salts under my nose. I had passed out apparently for a good ten minutes and they called the doctor to come in and resuscitate me. My blood pressure crashed and my heart stopped beating for about twenty seconds. I was so angry at all of them for bringing me back!!! I wanted to be in that meadow with the flowers!!! Not in this body with pain and blood!!! I Was so mad!!!! Oh, words can't describe it.
